topic: Sub-frame curved-arc shutter exposure versus linear velocity tangent blur
topic_zh: 亚帧圆弧快门积分与线性速度切线涂抹对比
scope: Deterministic 9-tap rotary shutter trajectory integration, radial error verification and Node CPU solving. No MoBGS or SplineGS neural training/inference, optical flow or physical sensor noise.

checks.name: phasor-equivalence-128

checks.name: atomic-shutter-rejection

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Incremental complex phasor rotation versus per-tap Math.cos/sin across 4 blades × 9 taps, not neural deblurring or GPU rendering.

protocol.function: shutter window [t-Δt/2, t+Δt/2] → 9 sub-frame timestamps → exact circular trajectory → zero radial overshoot

robustness.name: Sampled exposures retain exact R=2.2 radius under reverse visitation
